title: TrustTrade: Human-Inspired Selective Consensus Reduces Decision Uncertainty in LLM Trading Agents
central_strategy: Multiple independent report-generating LLM agents are filtered by semantic/numerical consensus and credibility, combined with deterministic multi-horizon temporal signals, then passed through sequential trader/risk-manager decisions and a short/long-term reflective memory bank to produce buy/sell/hold actions and discrete position sizes.

current_release_check.interface_role: human annotation/data-collection component only, not the selective-consensus temporal-memory agent

required_but_missing: Consensus agent count, exact models/revisions/prompts/settings, filled reports, and claim extraction schema.
Embedding model and the sigma/lambda/tau/alpha/high-consensus parameters that define filtering and weighting.
Temporal polynomial degree/fit, trend-score formula, forecast intervals, signal-combination weights, and action thresholds.
Reflective-memory window, retrieval rule, prompts/models, prior decisions, and risk-preference update logic.
2026 forward-run inputs/calls/timestamps, participant decisions, strategy actions, fills, costs, holdings, and NAV paths.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_interface_is_not_trusttrade: The deployed interface fixes a six-stage human experiment with $10,000, whole shares, and 25/50/75/100% sizing. It does not implement the paper's consensus graph, temporal model, sequential LLM trader/risk manager, or reflective memory.
monthly_jkp_assessment.temporal_validity_problem: Sixty-eight of 183 nominal-2024 stock-days contain explicit later-year references, including strong realized 2025/2026 facts, and four reports retain a final transaction proposal despite the claimed decision-content removal.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_jkp_cannot_fill_the_gap: JKP can provide numeric price/characteristic histories, but not the missing reports, claims, embeddings, consensus weights, human memory observations, or learned/reflected decisions needed to identify a score.

closure_rule: Do not relabel the human interface, inactive baseline table, three-stock static inputs, or a generic temporal factor as TrustTrade. Reopen for an attributable consensus/temporal/memory pipeline and causal decision outputs.
